name: ai.arcreport/ask
title: ARC: open benchmark of whether AI agents can buy
description: Free MCP for ARC's agent-commerce benchmark: read stores and protocols; submit stores or agent runs.

writeTools.submit_store: adds stores to the open directory (validated, plain HTTP)
writeTools.submit_leaderboard_run: submits an agent run against ARC-100 v1 (unverified until ARC re-runs a sample)
writeTools.can_agent_checkout: runs and saves a fresh plain-HTTP check of a public store (cached 24h)
